{"scratch": "Kitchen (Morning): counter_k1 is the active hub for mug_mara, tablet_mara, lunchbox_mara, and plate_shared_2. sink_k1 holds watering_can_mara; bowl_shared_2 migrates away from sink to counter/dish_rack during use. dish_rack_k1 is stable for shared cookware (pot_shared_1, plate_shared_1, mug_shared_1) and pen_mara. pan_shared_1 and bowl_shared_2 are volatile, moving between counter, sink, and rack.

Bathroom: High stability for care items. bathroom_shelf_ba1 holds hairbrush_mara, makeup_kit_mara, medication_bottle_mara (0.85+). towel_rack_ba1 exclusively holds towel_mara (0.95). Care items do not migrate to the rack.

Bedroom: nightstand_b1 is exclusive to phone_mara (0.85). Work items (laptop, charger) are absent at night/early morning. book_mara may migrate here at night.

Living Room: couch_l1 holds blanket_mara, book_mara, yoga_mat_mara. backpack_mara is NOT on the couch in early morning (prior 0.10); it migrates to entry or ON_PERSON. armchair_l1 is typically empty.

Entry (Early Morning): entry_hook_e1 is the primary transit hub for backpack_mara, charger_mara, and jacket_mara. charger_mara migrates here from desk_b1 during prep (prior 0.60). umbrella_mara is rarely on the hook (prior 0.10); it stays in bedroom or ON_PERSON. wallet_mara is often ON_PERSON during active use but appears on entry_table_e1 when resident is out.

General: Object locations remain stable when resident_1 is absent. Work items are not on the desk at night. headphones_mara are carried (ON_PERSON) in the morning, not in the Work Zone."}
